notes.title: Fighting Clans major update!
notes.notes:
We would like to thank everyone for the feedback and support that you have provided so far. We are back with another update!
Currently, Fighting Clans is still in a very early stage of development, which means you can expect the game to change a lot with each new update. 

Our development team is currently focused on fine-tuning the fighting mechanics to make them feel perfect. Once we achieve that, we plan to release more fighters for you to take down. Along the way, expect the games graphics to be polished as well—we strive to make this game look and feel good!

With this update, we have decided to start introducing the story of Fighting Clans. Welcome to Brookside: one of the toughest parts of America. The streets of Brookside have long been known to be run by some of the meanest, dirtiest, and strongest people that the world has ever seen. Law enforcement is nowhere to be found, and the fighting clans are what keep this city from falling apart. They all made pacts to keep their parts of town running smooth. But lately, the clans have not been sticking to their word. Fights have broken out all over Brookside. Will you survive?

As always, I would love to hear your feedback. You can always post a review here, reach out on Steam Forums, reach me on Reddit (u/simonov888), or even email me directly at es@xocus.co. The game is still in early access, which means your feedback is very important to us, and you can make change happen!

• Redesigned combat system physics
• Redesigned arms and legs of players
• Updated main menu
• New advanced graphics settings
• Optimized gameplay performance
• Improved visual components
• Implemented new physics for enemies
• Improved blocking mechanics
• Improved shock response from being hit
• Added facial animations
• Added new locations
• Added new enemies
• Bug fixes and stability improvements

Thanks to everyone for your feedback and support! We're now live!

The game is still in an extremely early stage, so expect lots of changes in the short term.

Short term focus will be on getting the fighting mechanics just right, and then more opponents will follow after that. The visual polish will be worked in along the way.

As always, I'd love to hear your feedback, either over on the Steam forums, on Reddit (where I'm u/simonov888), or directly at my email address at es@xocus.co. The game is still in Early Access.
